text.en:
Dealing Explosive damage grants a stack of 'Blast Distributor' for 5? seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

'Blast Distributor' grants #e${10+#d} Grenade stat per stack.

enhanced (
#e Grants 1? more Grenade stat per stack.
)

Dealing Explosive damage grants a stack of 'Blast Distributor' for 5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

'Blast Distributor' grants #e${10+#d} Grenade stat per stack.

enhanced (
var d = 3
#e Grants 3 more Grenade stat per stack.
)

Dealing Explosive Weapon damage grants a stack of 'Blast Distributor' for 5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

'Blast Distributor' grants #e${10+#d} Grenade Stat per stack.

enhanced (
var d = 3
#e Grants 3 more Grenade Stat per stack.
)
